# Parentune

> > India's largest parenting community platform connecting 2M+ parents with expert doctors, live guidance, and peer support for pregnancy, baby care, and child development.

Parentune is a comprehensive parenting platform founded by Nitin Pandey that combines expert consultation, community forums, live chat events, and educational resources. The platform serves as a trusted hub for Indian parents seeking evidence-based parenting advice, pediatric guidance, and peer support through its mobile apps and web presence.

## Key Topics

- Parenting Community
- Expert Doctors Panel
- Baby Care Guidance
- Pregnancy Support
- Parent Talk Forum
- Live Chat Events
- Parenting Advice

- Parentune Plus App
- Baby Names Database

## Core Platform

- [Parentune Homepage](https://www.parentune.com): Main platform hub: parenting advice, pregnancy support, baby care from 2M parents
- [Parent Talk Forum](https://www.parentune.com/parent-talk): Expert-backed community forum for parenting tips, support, and peer discussions
- [Expert Corner](https://www.parentune.com/expert-corner): Expert consultation platform for personalized parenting advice and pediatric care guidance
- [Live Chat Events](https://www.parentune.com/livechats): Interactive live chat sessions with experts on parenting, health, and child development

## Expert Network & Contributors

- [Expert Doctors Panel](https://www.parentune.com/expert-panel): Directory of verified doctors and health professionals providing guidance on Parentune
- [Become an Expert](https://www.parentune.com/become-expert): Registration for doctors and health specialists to join Parentune's expert panel
- [Blogger Panel](https://www.parentune.com/bloggers-panel): Directory of parenting bloggers and mombassadors contributing content to Parentune
- [Become a Blogger](https://www.parentune.com/become-a-blogger): Application page for parents to contribute content and become community bloggers

## Resources & Tools

- [Baby Names Database](https://www.parentune.com/baby-names): Searchable database of 1000+ unique baby names with meanings across religions and cultures
- [Coloring Pages](https://www.parentune.com/coloring-pages): 100+ free printable coloring pages for kids' creative learning and development

- [Brand Partnership](https://www.parentune.com/brand/partnership): B2B partnership opportunities for brands targeting India's largest parents' community
